purpose: S-Series campaign qualification and admission discipline; not a network runtime

qualificationManifest.fingerprintRule: sha256 over canonical sorted path/blob pairs for each S-sensitive block surface

sSeriesExtensions.name: provider-access-quota
sSeriesExtensions.acceptance: all seven required provider families ready; blocked_access/missing quota/missing deployment is RED; no substitution

sSeriesExtensions.name: provider-websocket-pressure
sSeriesExtensions.acceptance: 50 persistent sockets survive heartbeat; 1013 socket_backpressure reconnects; exactly one provider execution

sSeriesExtensions.name: paired-economics
sSeriesExtensions.acceptance: paired provider input-token reduction >= 90% and comparable variable inference-cost reduction >= 90%

admissionAlgorithm: freeze public/private candidate pair and BASE_SHA pair before expensive qualification
retain expensive qualification evidence for that frozen candidate pair
when either main moves, compare BASE_SHA to current main and map changed paths to S-sensitive blocks
recalculate per-block fingerprints on the integration candidate immediately before merge/admission
reuse frozen candidate evidence for unchanged blocks
run only affected zero-paid/targeted block qualification for changed sensitive blocks
require a new live S successor only when targeted qualification cannot establish compatibility or a changed block explicitly requires live proof
re-read both mains immediately before merge/campaign and rerun only the cheap admission analysis if the admission snapshot moved
campaignRule: A paid S-Series campaign may start exactly once only from a frozen candidate pair with accepted expensive evidence plus a GREEN admission-to-current-main manifest, targeted requalification for every changed S-sensitive block, and a fresh collision/capacity check. Current main need not equal the frozen candidate SHA pair.
forbidden: provider substitution under the seven-vendor gate
campaign dispatch from stale admission evidence
reuse of D-Series launcher or evidence namespaces
rerun of immutable historical S attempts
automatic full S rerun solely because main moved
discarding frozen candidate evidence because unrelated main changed
merge or campaign authorization based only on an old GREEN branch SHA
skipping BASE_SHA to current-main impact analysis
treating admission snapshot movement as invalidation of frozen candidate evidence
